rationale: For an English learning app, the interface must feel encouraging, structured, and rewarding. We avoid the clinical 'SaaS' look by using tactile UI elements (3D-like buttons with bottom borders), vibrant but carefully controlled accent colors, and friendly, rounded typography. The design promotes progression and reduces cognitive load, much like Duolingo, but maintains a slightly more mature 'Coach' aesthetic.

button.primary_tactile: relative flex items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-sky-400 px-6 py-3 font-bold text-white transition-all hover:bg-sky-500 border-b-4 border-sky-600 active:border-b-0 active:translate-y-1 active:mt-1
button.secondary_tactile: relative flex items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-white px-6 py-3 font-bold text-slate-700 transition-all hover:bg-slate-50 border-2 border-slate-200 border-b-4 hover:border-slate-300 active:border-b-2 active:translate-y-[2px] active:mt-[2px]
button.success_tactile: relative flex items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-green-400 px-6 py-3 font-bold text-white transition-all hover:bg-green-500 border-b-4 border-green-600 active:border-b-0 active:translate-y-1 active:mt-1

card.base: bg-white rounded-3xl border-2 border-slate-100 p-6 shadow-sm
card.interactive: bg-white rounded-3xl border-2 border-slate-200 p-6 shadow-sm transition-all hover:-translate-y-1 hover:border-sky-300 hover:shadow-md cursor-pointer

progress_bar.fill: h-full rounded-full bg-sky-400 relative after:absolute after:top-1 after:left-1 after:right-1 after:h-1.5 after:bg-white/30 after:rounded-full

inputs.text: w-full rounded-xl border-2 border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 p-4 font-medium text-slate-900 transition-colors focus:border-sky-400 focus:bg-white focus:outline-none focus:ring-4 focus:ring-sky-400/20

motion.page_transition: framer-motion opacity-0 translate-y-4 to opacity-100 translate-y-0 duration-300
motion.success_pop: framer-motion scale 0.8 to 1.1 to 1.0 with spring physics (stiffness 300, damping 15)

icons.sizing: w-6 h-6 or w-8 h-8 for larger features

image_urls.placement: Landing page hero section or login screen
Background decoration for Gamification/Level up screens
Lesson category cover image or dashboard banner
Profile page placeholder or top nav avatar

media.guidelines: Do not use generic placeholder links. Use the provided Unsplash/Pexels images. Utilize framer-motion to add subtle float animations to abstract decorative images.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: Do not use generic Inter font. Import 'Nunito' for headings and 'Manrope' for body from Google Fonts in index.html or global css.
Use @phosphor-icons/react in duotone weight exclusively to match the playful gamified theme.

Apply the 'tactile' button styles provided in the components section to all primary CTAs to create a gamified, physical feel. The buttons use border-b-4 to create 3D depth, which disappears on active state.
Data structure: Use a standard Tailwind grid (md:grid-cols-12) for the dashboard. A 8-col section for Main Lessons/Path and a 4-col sticky sidebar for User Stats (Streaks, XP, Leaderboard).
All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, lesson cards, streak icons) MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g. data-testid='start-lesson-button').
For the Progress Bar, add the 'after:absolute after:top-1 after:left-1...' inner highlight utility detailed in components.progress_bar to make the bar look glassy and 3D.
Use standard Shadcn components for Dialogs, Dropdowns, and Toasts, but override their border-radii to rounded-2xl/rounded-3xl and replace standard borders with our softer slate-200 borders.
Avoid complete black text. Use text-slate-900 or text-slate-800 for maximum readability while keeping the design soft.
Use framer-motion to create a springy, bouncy entrance for badges, success screens, or streak updates.
